name: Failed low with quote-depth confirmation
hypothesis: Buy a reclaim of the prior low only after successful full-size quotes and independent inflow confirmation.
spec: Setup: A brief new low may reverse when genuine exit liquidity remains intact. Entry: Buy a reclaim of the prior low only after successful full-size quotes and independent inflow confirmation. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit at a new low or the preselected range midpoint/high. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs transaction-derived bars or launch/migration anchors from on-chain data
